title: RepresentationMandate
description: PACK-09, Framework 0.8.1 section 13.1. Owned by compliance-service (epd2_compliance_service.casework.RepresentationMandate). A mandate is an ENUMERATED SET OF AUTHORITIES, not a role name (Framework hard invariant 15: a role name is not proof of authority). Nothing downstream may infer that a representative can settle a case from the fact that a representative exists. Revocation is forward-looking: acts already accepted under the mandate stay valid and the docket is not rewritten. No field in this payload carries an identity attribute, a global person identifier, a party or authority handle, a document or its bytes, message content, an authentication secret, or any ballot/vote/tally/delegation reference (PACK-09 required invariants 1, 11, 12 and 13; Framework 0.8.1 section 11).
